alt: The beach and pool of Jetwing Yala at the edge of the national park

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Yala at dawn is the single best morning you can have in Sri Lanka. Leopards are shy, but the elephants and peacocks never disappoint.
expert.tip: Wear neutral colours for the safari and keep the camera ready at the waterholes. The first hour after the gates open is when the cats move.

summary: The Fully Loaded route in upgraded hotels: a soft landing in Colombo, two nights in Kandy with Sigiriya and the dance show, a night at the five star Jetwing Yala with a private dawn safari, two nights at a four star beach resort in Bentota with Mirissa, and a final night in the capital.
included: Included: 7 nights in deluxe, four and five star hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; private Pinnawala visit; private Kandy lake drive and dance show; a private excursion to Sigiriya; private full day Kandy sightseeing; a private jungle safari in Yala National Park; a private excursion to Mirissa; private full day Colombo sightseeing.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
